rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan

insights: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 4.51% (14.79% vs 10.28%).
Beat the benchmark in 100.0% of rolling windows — strong consistency for a Hybrid: Dynamic Asset Allocation.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.97 vs 0.89) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Aggressive profile: beta 1.45 with 18.7% annualised volatility vs benchmark 11.1%.
Positive alpha of 3.69% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.76).
Drawdown protection: max drawdown -31.32% vs benchmark -16.76% — shallower losses in downturns.
Rolling return range spans 8.97% to 18.45% (9.48 pp spread) — consistency score 100.
This fund satisfies all three Golden Triangle conditions.
